boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 石門洞（北觀國家風景區官方列名，台2線28.7k；海蝕洞經海浪沖鑿與地殼抬升形成高約10公尺的海蝕拱門，步道與觀景平台）地質主體（OSM viewpoint 節點；海拔誠實留空）；與既有 tw-073 老梅綠石槽（2.44km）與 tw-143 富貴角風稜石（3.21km）題材錯位——綠石槽為石礁藻類主體、風稜石為礫灘風蝕主體，本點為海蝕拱門主體。
boosters_i18n.en: Shimen Cave (officially listed by the North Coast NSAA at the 28.7k mark on Highway 2; waves and uplift carved a sea arch about 10 m tall, with a shore walkway and platforms). Disjoint from tw-073 Laomei green-reef 2.44 km and tw-143 Fuguijiao wind-eroded pebbles 3.21 km away (algae-reef and ventifact subjects vs sea-arch subject).
